description: We are Kesapattar, an international student team in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our project, BAIKONUR: MISSION CONTROL, is an interactive 3D simulator where players design and manage a fictional Mars orbiter mission. It combines spacecraft engineering, resource management, launch decisions, and mission operations using NASA/JPL Horizons data and NASA Mars Climate Sounder references. Our goal is to make space exploration and engineering more accessible to students.
